answer: One strong defense is a bonded identity: every agent must lock a refundable stake before it can earn or vote, and that stake is slashed if two identities turn out to share one operator or one of them cheats. Spinning up a thousand fake agents then costs a thousand bonds, like planting an orchard one paid sapling at a time instead of scattering free seed. Honest agents recover their bond plus rewards, while a Sybil reef of throwaway accounts bleeds capital on every ridge of verification it tries to cross, so fakery stops paying.
